notice: A starter prepares an editable request. Review it and send it to the connected VISTA project.

prompts.title: Plan the full TVA workflow
prompts.description: Review the four science stages and their handoffs.
prompts.livePrompt: Prepare a read-only plan for our TVA water–energy workflow: HEADWATER precipitation, air-temperature and runoff forecasts; physical reconstruction and high-resolution downscaling; LSTM water availability; and economic assessment. Describe each stage’s inputs, outputs and verified integration status. Include the optional TRITON and RiTHyMs paths only when the plant handoff requires them. Identify missing skills, files, model mappings and runtime prerequisites. For approved tasks, plan to save generated figures, tables, reports and provenance in the VISTA project outputs and display the result files. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Explore reservoirs and gages
prompts.description: Distinguish the 12 headwater reservoirs from other study locations.
prompts.livePrompt: Review the TVA study network of reservoirs and gages. Prioritize the requested headwater reservoirs: Norris, Douglas, South Holston, Watauga, Fontana, Blue Ridge, Normandy, Tims Ford, Chatuge, Nottely, Wolf Creek, Dale Hollow. Distinguish those 12 reservoirs from the other study locations. Treat Estimated Local Flow as a reference quantity, not a site type. Verify available location mappings, quantity definitions, forcing coverage and runnable model support. Wolf Creek and Dale Hollow are included study locations, but their model-site mappings and inputs are not supplied; do not claim they are ready for inference. Do not sum overlapping or allocated flows. Use read-only inspection and planning. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Show the project’s loaded skills
prompts.description: Inspect the live count, available tools and model coverage.
prompts.livePrompt: List the skills currently loaded into this TVA project, report their total count, and explain the available scientific tools and jobs. Map verified capabilities onto HEADWATER, downscaling, LSTM water availability, optional TRITON/RiTHyMs and economic assessment. Distinguish a science-stage definition from an installed runnable skill. Use read-only inspection; identify missing prerequisites. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Inspect the HEADWATER handoff
prompts.description: Check variables, forecast timing, ensemble members and units.
prompts.livePrompt: Prepare a read-only HEADWATER handoff check for precipitation, air temperature and runoff for the headwater reservoirs. Inspect available files for grid, coordinate reference, physical units, forecast issue time, valid time and ensemble member IDs. The project discussion describes residual/probability maps; establish the physical-variable reconstruction and reference contract before downstream use. Report only properties supported by the files and identify missing prerequisites. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Plan high-resolution downscaling
prompts.description: Follow the regional fields toward the 1 km target.
prompts.livePrompt: Prepare a read-only reconstruction and downscaling plan from HEADWATER forecast maps to physical precipitation, air-temperature and runoff fields. The project discussion names a 4 km intermediate grid and 1 km target. Identify the actual available implementation or skill, grids, units and time/member metadata. Explain aggregation into the forcing regions required by the LSTM. Report implementation and input gaps rather than assuming the target is runnable. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Prepare an LSTM inference plan
prompts.description: Verify the selected location, model mapping and inputs first.
prompts.livePrompt: Prepare a read-only inference plan for the saved TVA LSTM at the selected study location, prioritizing the requested headwater reservoirs. Identify the loaded skill, verified model-site mapping, matched forcing CSV/metadata, required preceding input weeks, static attributes, checkpoint, environment and compatible compute resource. Explain output units and the site reference quantity. Verify every requested location’s input coverage; do not assume the study list is model coverage. Wolf Creek and Dale Hollow require new model mappings and inputs before inference. Show exact proposed job settings and expected saved project-output artifacts. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Check the plant data interface
prompts.description: Align water quantity, temperature, timestamps and provenance.
prompts.livePrompt: Review the available plant handoff files using read-only tools. Check site-to-plant mapping, water quantity and its definition, units, water temperature when needed, time aggregation, forecast issue/member IDs, quality flags and provenance. Identify whether TRITON hydraulics or RiTHyMs water temperature is required and whether the corresponding capability exists. Propose a consistent handoff schema from verified data. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Prepare the economic assessment
prompts.description: Clarify generation, cost and risk inputs and assumptions.
prompts.livePrompt: Prepare a read-only economic-assessment handoff plan for Georgia Tech using verified plant water records. Identify the plant/economic data, model/interface and assumptions needed for generation, cost and risk metrics. Separate available files from missing partner inputs. Do not infer economic impacts from an LSTM output alone. Specify the figures, result tables and provenance that an approved assessment should save in project outputs. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.

prompts.title: Organize the generated results
prompts.description: Collect figures, tables and reports in the Results Library.
prompts.livePrompt: Review this conversation’s actual generated files and the selected VISTA project outputs. Identify available figures, prediction tables, reports and provenance. Save a concise result summary as a project output and use display_file for the resulting summary and relevant figures/tables so they appear in this workspace and Results Library. Retain original file names, scientific units and provenance, distinguish pending jobs from completed results, and identify missing artifacts. Do not manufacture a result when a file or completed run is absent. Do not submit jobs, train, install software, change settings or fabricate outputs. Show any proposed compute plan and wait for my explicit confirmation before submission.
